keep.text: Doston, ye ek exercise hai
jo aap logon ka BP gira sakti hai.
Isko kehte hain wall sit.
Aur
ismein koi gym nahi jaana hai,
ismein
aap logon ko bahut zyada daudna nahi hai.
Bas
ek deewar chahiye aap logon ko, jis pe peeth deewar pe lagaani hai, aur 90 second ke liye ghutne
90 degree par mode rakhne hain.
Theek? Jitna ho paaye utna karo.
But
isse simple toh kuch ho nahi sakta.
Ab
ye sawaal uthta hai ki ye BP giraayegi kaise?
Toh uske liye science suniye,
kyunki ye bahut zyada interesting hai.
Jab aap wall sit pe hold karte ho, toh muscle aap logon ki squeeze hoti hai,
lekin
move nahi ho rahi hoti hai.
Isko kehte hain isometric contraction.
Aur jab muscle squeeze ho rahi hoti hai,
toh blood vessels compress ho rahe hote hain,
blood flow aapka temporarily restrict ho jaata hai, aur
jab aap chhodte hain isko, toh blood rush aata hai,
turant vessels ekdam dilate ho jaate hain.
Aur ye process baar baar karne se
vessels jo hain aapke, wo flexible bante hain,
aur
endothelium function improve ho jaata hai.
Aur
sabse important cheez ye hai ki ye saari cheezein karne se body mein aapke nitric oxide
banne lagti hai.
Aur nitric oxide aapki body ka natural
vasodilator hai,
yaani ki Telmisartan jo cheez karta hai, wo saari cheezein aap logon ki
nitric oxide karne lagti hai.
2025 ki ek meta analysis hui thi, 30 studies pe, 1700 participants the ismein. Isometric exercise se systolic BP 7 point gira tha, 7 mmHg
point gira,
aur diastolic 3
point gira.
British Journal of Sports Medicine ka ek network
meta analysis hota hai,
aur
sabse effective exercise mode jo kaha gaya hai un logon ko
BP reduction ke liye,
wo isometric exercise, yaani ki running se bhi zyada
ye wall sitting is important.
Swimming se bhi zyada wall sitting is important.
Weight training se zyada wall sitting is important. Toh isometric exercises
hi aisi hain
jo BP ko achhe tareeke se
gira sakti hain.
Kaise karna hai?
Wall sit karke maine bataya,
wall ko back pe lagaaiye
is tareeke se,
aur isko neeche 90 degrees pe apna ghutna mod dijiye.
Simple si exercise hai, jitni der ho paaye utni der baithiye.
Ek minute, do minute, aur is tareeke se aap log
jab regular karna shuru kar doge,
toh aap log apne
body mein changes dekhna shuru kar doge.
Meri wife ne bhi yahi kiya hai.
Deewar ke saath pehle teen din sirf aur sirf
30 second bhi nahi ho paate the usko wall sit.
But dheere dheere dheere usne
saari cheezein cover karna shuru kar diya.
Aaj do minute ka target laga karke aaraam se baith jaati hai.
Aapke paas gym nahi hai, aapke paas equipment nahi hai, aapke paas
kya kya cheezein nahi hongi,
deewar toh aisi cheez hai jo kahin bhi mil jaayegi aapko.
Wo toh, wahan toh aap bahaana nahi maar sakte ho.
Main bata raha hoon, ye proven hai. Abhi aaj se hi try karna shuru kar dijiye isko.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka. You are watching FitFinfluencer, milte hain
